nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the Gessel alphabet over $S = [n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ is the disjoint union of an unbarred copy and a barred copy of $[n]$: it has an unbarred letter $i$ and a barred letter $\bar{i}$ for each $i \in [n]$.
nodes.title: Gessel alphabet

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a word over the Gessel alphabet over $[n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ and let $m$ be a natural number. The signed balance of $m$ in $w$ is the integer obtained by subtracting the number of occurrences of the barred letter $\bar{m}$ in $w$ from the number of occurrences of the unbarred letter $m$ in $w$; it is $0$ when $m \notin [n]$.
nodes.title: Signed balance of a label

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a word (a finite sequence of letters) over the Gessel alphabet over $[n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ and let $m$ be a natural number. The barred count of $m$ in $w$ is the number of positions of $w$ that hold the barred letter $\bar{m}$; it is $0$ when $m \notin [n]$.
nodes.title: Barred occurrences of a label

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a word (a finite sequence of letters) over the Gessel alphabet over $[n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ and let $m$ be a natural number. The unbarred count of $m$ in $w$ is the number of positions of $w$ that hold the unbarred letter $m$; it is $0$ when $m \notin [n]$.
nodes.title: Unbarred occurrences of a label

nodes.summary: A word $w$ over the Gessel alphabet of $[n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ is a complete Gessel word if and only if it is a Gessel word and, for every $m \in [n]$, the signed balance of $m$ in $w$ (the number of occurrences of the unbarred letter $m$ minus the number of occurrences of the barred letter $\bar m$) is zero.
nodes.title: Complete Gessel words are the Gessel words of zero balance

nodes.summary: A word $w$ over the Gessel alphabet of $S = [n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ is a complete Gessel word when it is a Gessel word and, for every $m \in [n]$, the unbarred letter $m$ and the barred letter $\bar m$ occur the same number of times in $w$.
nodes.title: Complete Gessel words

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number. For a word $u$ over the Gessel alphabet over $S = [n] = \{1, \dots, n\}$ and a natural number $m$, write $\beta_u(m)$ for the signed balance of $m$ in $u$: the number of occurrences of the unbarred letter $m$ in $u$ minus the number of occurrences of the barred letter $\bar{m}$ in $u$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
